verdicts.reason: A breaks the design into three unrelated pieces spread across the banner: the yellow headline card on the left, an empty outlined frame in the middle that holds nothing, and the photo on the right. A yellow accent stub also floats in the top-right corner, and the headline no longer sits on the photo, so the layering is lost; but the headline is readable and the layout does read left to right. B just shrinks the whole original and centres it, leaving about 75% of the canvas as dead white on both sides, and 'LOVE. CARE. KIDS.' becomes tiny, barely legible text, which is exactly the shrink-not-rearrange failure the brief warns against.
